description: UNICAMP’s UNISIM group publishes a family of reservoir benchmarks for development strategy, management, history matching and uncertainty reduction. The collection includes synthetic carbonate, karstic and high-carbon-dioxide reservoir cases. The provider is UNISIM, CEPETRO, UNICAMP. Coverage: These are defined benchmark models with case-specific geometries and schedules. Edition years in the collection do not constitute a shared observational period. Access: The provider lists named cases and their documentation pages. No benchmark files were downloaded. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ODbL-1.0 (database); DbCL-1.0 (contents). Access is free of charge. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Each case has separate assumptions and access conditions. For simulation they supply repeatable comparison cases across reservoir-management methods. Related resources: The UNISIM academic reservoir benchmarks are distinct from Honeywell’s UniSim process-simulation software.
